name: frankenstein-creation-scene
description: Real public-domain multi-edition witness pair (BACKLOG B4): the opening two paragraphs of the creation scene from Mary Shelley's Frankenstein, Chapter 5 ('It was on a dreary night of November…'), as printed in the 1818 first edition versus the revised 1831 edition. Substantive view (accidentals folded). The 1818->1831 changes in this passage are almost entirely accidental (punctuation/hyphenation), so a correct substantive collation should report near-identity; the one surfaced variant (dun white -> dun-white) is a genuine tokenisation effect, not a wording change. See docs/development/CASE_STUDY.md.

source.work: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, Chapter 5 (creation scene, first two paragraphs)
source.1818: Project Gutenberg eBook #41445 (photo-reprint of the 1818 first edition)
